actual_blender_pose_review.views: 7 aligned genuine Blender PBR stills per version, fixed camera and light, sampled 1/10/19/27/34/46/65
strengths: Distinct 12-bone armature with elbow and knee child segments and smooth distal influence
No artificial translation of the root, idle start and end remain identical
No obvious tearing in sampled broad poses at 600x480
problems: Compared with V2 at attack frame 27, the active claw does not extend nearly as far: the pose reads as crouch rather than forceful swipe.
Most distal articulation differences remain local and the overall silhouette improvement is not clearly stronger from this view.
PBR isolated images and structural checks do not certify animation quality in strategic Unity gameplay.

next_hypothesis: First use refined v3 source and captured same-camera A/B as technical candidate. Avoid rerunning Qwen or replacing production. Do not automatically generate V4 solely to chase pixel-count; the next material quality test is Unity animated-import/strategic game framing and if failed then targeted Blender character direction.

follow_up_same_day_refined_pose.visual_review: Later refined run restores the long forward claw reach comparable to V2 while retaining distinct elbow/knee skinning. From locked isometric Blender preview a clear improvement over V2 in character acting is NOT yet evident, though segmented-bone technical potential is proved.
follow_up_same_day_refined_pose.next_gate: Isolated Unity 6000.3 animated GLB/glTFast import, clip playback and true tactical camera A/B; Windows runner currently reserved by UI workstream. No game mutation.
